During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] '''stormed''' a [[Thul Palace|compound]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] belonging to the Imperial-aligned [[House of Thul|House Thul]]. Having learned that the supposed Republic researcher [[Aleyna Hark]] was actually an Imperial spy with the targeting device of the [[Death Mark laser]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] raced to rescue [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Horis Thul]] before Hark could kill him with the stolen Republic superweapon and sabotage the peace talks with [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]].
